sections.advice: Whistler → Pemberton is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Sea-to-Sky Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 59 km this is Sea-to-Sky Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Duffey Lake Road
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 65 km. 1275 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Duffey Lake Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 1275 m come off over 21 km at around 11.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

duffey-lake-road.story: From Whistler it runs 244 km to Lillooet; allow about 3 h 20 of riding. The stops in between: Pemberton, Cayoosh Pass and Duffey Lake. The highest point is about 1,800 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
